value.rationale: The first non-thin valuation strata are natural and historically singled out; determining their intrinsic abstract algebras uncovers the unexpected reversal between valuation thinness and abstract monomializability. The exact smooth automorphism schemes separate the two seven-dimensional families by two dimensions across arbitrary characteristics. This is a meaningful structural boundary, not another count of known embedded subalgebras.
